notes: Fixed a phone-number bug: profiles located in Russia, Ukraine, Austria, Australia, or Mauritius could get the wrong country dial code silently prepended (e.g. a Moscow number tagged +1 instead of +7), because the short "us"/"uk" abbreviations matched as substrings of those country names before the real country entry got a chance to. Also fixed conversations opened later in an already-open LinkedIn Messaging tab not syncing to the CRM — only conversations open at page load were being captured.
